notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose what we tell you, and how.

device.on: Reminders and updates arrive even when the app is closed.
device.off: Turn on to get reminders and updates as notifications.
device.testSent: Sent. It should appear in a few seconds.
device.testNone: No device got it. Turn notifications off and on again.
device.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
device.disabled: Notifications are off for this device.
device.dismissed: No problem. You can allow notifications any time.
device.unavailable: Notifications on the phone aren't available yet.
device.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Open the app in Chrome, Safari or Edge.
device.unsupportedIos: Update your iPhone to iOS 16.4 or later to get notifications.
device.installTitle: Add the app to your Home Screen
device.install: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work in the app added to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later).
device.deniedIos: Open Settings → Notifications → {{app}} and turn on Allow Notifications.
device.deniedAndroid: Tap and hold the app icon → App info → Notifications, and allow them. In the browser: tap the icon next to the address → Notifications → Allow.
device.deniedDesktop: Click the icon to the left of the address → Notifications → Allow. Then choose Check again.
device.preview: Notifications work in the published app, not in this preview.
device.notReady: Notifications are still getting ready on this device. Check again in a moment.
device.demo: This is a shared demo account: notifications stay off and changes aren't saved.
